ACTUAL_HTTP_DISPATCH_BOUNDARIES.aiohttp: ClientRequest.send per actual request; ClientResponse.start notices denial at headers; complete body/release closes accounting.
ACTUAL_HTTP_DISPATCH_BOUNDARIES.httpx: HTTPTransport.handle_request and AsyncHTTPTransport.handle_async_request; response stream close completes accounting.
ACTUAL_HTTP_DISPATCH_BOUNDARIES.shared_adapters_and_analyzers: Process-wide hooks installed at the start of the three accepted role modules, covering direct GET/POST, redirects, retry and fallback transports regardless of application RPC label.
ACTUAL_HTTP_DISPATCH_BOUNDARIES.stdlib_requests_urllib3: HTTPConnection.putrequest/endheaders/getresponse; urllib3 prepared body captured before first HTTP bytes. Every wire retry re-enters.
ACTUAL_HTTP_DISPATCH_BOUNDARIES.tls_backstop: Unknown Python SSLContext Helius clients refuse; accepted gated WebSocket handshakes have a non-leaking connection-only permit.

DURABLE_RESERVATION_ACCOUNTING.atomicity: Exclusive cross-process flock; PENDING marker fsync, bounded stage fsync, atomic replace, directory fsync, READY checksum fsync before wire dispatch.
DURABLE_RESERVATION_ACCOUNTING.owner: Existing helius_denial_gate.Gate and existing stable JSON/lock files; no new database/service.
DURABLE_RESERVATION_ACCOUNTING.privacy: Only hashes, counters, role, PID, selector and state; no credentials, raw RPC payloads or canonical evidence.
DURABLE_RESERVATION_ACCOUNTING.quota_full: Explicit fail-closed deferral, never silent pruning, identity reuse, archive growth or allowance reset. Finite identity capacity must be part of production policy review.
DURABLE_RESERVATION_ACCOUNTING.refunds: No credit refunds implemented. Processing-claim compensation after budget refusal is distinct from spending refunds.
DURABLE_RESERVATION_ACCOUNTING.restart: No initialization from missing/corrupt state; no automatic counter reset; ambiguous/crashed reservations remain charged and occupy in-flight capacity.

EXACT_REMAINING_GATE: Freeze a verified production cost/limit policy: accepted billing evidence and worst-case weights for every permitted request variant/batch size, operator-approved allocations, and explicit finite ledger capacity disposition. The empty-cost proposal is intentionally rejected by configure_budget. No guessed pricing or production allowance is installed.

GLOBAL_CREDIT_LIMITS.billing: No live billing weights are claimed verified. Unknown selectors and batch sizes refuse; tests use labelled synthetic units only.
GLOBAL_CREDIT_LIMITS.clock_contract: Persist wall and monotonic high-water marks. Rollback, reboot/monotonic regression, or >5-second elapsed-clock divergence refuses admission.
GLOBAL_CREDIT_LIMITS.window_contract: Conservative rolling upper bounds: charge current plus previous anchored bucket. May defer longer than an exact sliding window; never grants a boundary double-burst.

NEXT_ACTION: Freeze that policy while PAYMENT_DENIED, then perform the existing read-only coordinated three-role deployment preflight against this candidate. Do not deploy, restore/probe Helius, replay queues or freeze the Golden Baseline.

PER_TOKEN_AND_INVESTIGATION_LIMITS.identity: Nested shared mint and signature-investigation scopes. Unknown mint stays unknown; signature-only work is scoped as an investigation until independently resolved. Exact request hashes keep distinct signatures, ranges, endpoints and batch membership distinct.
PER_TOKEN_AND_INVESTIGATION_LIMITS.scope_lifetime: No automatic reset or expiry of investigation counters.

PER_WORKER_LIMITS.allocation_window: Conservative rolling daily worker allocation; cannot borrow another role allocation.

PRODUCTION_AUTHORITY.BIRDEYE: Authority and budgets unchanged; no credential values read or published.

PROVIDER_FREE_TEST_RESULTS.network: Socket connection paths forbidden in fixtures; fake HTTP wires and separate budget-only worker processes. Zero provider calls.
PROVIDER_FREE_TEST_RESULTS.unchanged_acceptance: Existing broader CREATE, terminal, Walkback, operation and Birdeye matrices retained; no historical audit or migration rerun.

RETRY_AND_PAGINATION_BOUNDS.deduplication: Shared simultaneous exact-request suppression; bounded >=60-second post-completion cooldown and retry charging. HTTP completion is not a claim that canonical evidence is retained. Existing canonical readers and caches are unchanged.
RETRY_AND_PAGINATION_BOUNDS.denial: 402 PAYMENT_DENIED; 401/403 AUTH_DENIED; 429 RATE_LIMITED with bounded Retry-After. Denial persists at response headers without premature in-flight release.
RETRY_AND_PAGINATION_BOUNDS.pending_work: PumpPortal independent intake unchanged. Migration journal admission remains before acquisition. Budget-only journal claim compensation is compare-and-set against attempt count and dispatch fence. Walkback compensates only its own claimed attempt; creator Deferred path preserves attempts. No canonical overwrite, acknowledgement, retry reset or replay.
RETRY_AND_PAGINATION_BOUNDS.recovery: Completed HTTP response may be reacquired after cooldown within existing hard retry/credit limits, allowing recovery after process-local cache loss. HTTP404 stays bounded-retryable, not invented permanent evidence failure.
RETRY_AND_PAGINATION_BOUNDS.reservation: Each actual HTTP attempt, redirect, fallback and page reserves credits; enhanced POST batches require an entire-batch cost selector bound to submitted count.

STORAGE_HEADROOM.new_database_or_wal_allocation: No new live database or WAL owner; all SQLite fixtures disposable. No absolute live WAL guarantee claimed.
STORAGE_HEADROOM.prior_iterations_cleanup: Only these task-owned synthetic fixtures removed after allocation recording; no historical/production data deleted.
STORAGE_HEADROOM.sampling_limit: Not a continuous guarantee against unrelated disk users; each real gate publication enforces its floor.

UNGUARDED_PATHS.limits: Application-process protection, not an account-wide network firewall. Unrelated processes, shared-key users and native/raw-IP transports outside the frozen source are not controlled. The October26 billed caller remains unattributed.
UNGUARDED_PATHS.qualified_registered_python_transports: No bypass observed in the provider-free boundary tests.
UNGUARDED_PATHS.source_inventory: All directly imported HTTP libraries in the three runtime src trees are requests, urllib/urllib3, aiohttp and httpx. No direct raw socket/curl/native HTTP transport was found in those trees.
